verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a transaction-monitoring workflow type that monitors transaction events in real time or on a schedule, applies policy logic, and generates alerts when thresholds are met. Events can also be routed to monitoring Source Workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows thresholds varying by customer segment, and the rule-configuration surface for a compliance officer is only implied. Missing for 10: segment-specific threshold configuration, detailed rule-builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds

citations.quote: Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
any event can be submitted for additional monitoring by mapping the event type to a Source Workflow.
Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
